boundary: One warm authenticated SSH connection, three persistent resident channels and one shared small JSON guest echo channel. Six permutations alternate resident order; gateway/echo/ping measurement order rotates. Three warm-up pings per resident are excluded. No generated bulk traffic or agent input; background traffic uncontrolled. Client pacing is fixed for every variant, so this compares staged cloud variants rather than changing both endpoints' budgets. Not a UI typing/rendering test.

primary_full_design_cycle.method: Paired non-overlapping block bootstrap over successive rounds; each resampled block keeps all three variants together. Empirical percentile intervals, exploratory and conditional on observed background traffic; not proof of causality or immunity to environmental variation.

sensitivity_shorter_blocks.method: Paired non-overlapping block bootstrap over successive rounds; each resampled block keeps all three variants together. Empirical percentile intervals, exploratory and conditional on observed background traffic; not proof of causality or immunity to environmental variation.

provenance.analysis_plan: Before inspecting repeat results: paired block bootstrap, 10000 resamples, primary block18 rounds preserving a full joint design cycle, sensitivity block6 rounds; compare 128/96 P95 minus each alternative. Intervals crossing zero do not establish a repeatable advantage.
provenance.client_budget: Fixed 160/128 KiB/s for all three cloud variants; small probes only
provenance.clock: Mac UTC timestamps and monotonic elapsed RTT; no cross-host clock subtraction
provenance.order_correction: Prior mode gave 4/1/1 probe positions per variant over six rounds. Corrected 18-round joint cycle gives every variant each resident/probe position combination equally often. Input terminal order changed from A,B,C to C,A,B. This is a corrected-method repeat, not an identical-method replication.
provenance.scope: Singapore-to-US warm protocol RTT, not US-local latency or UI response; varying cloud budgets with a common client

server.evidence: GCP inventory checked around 2026-11-16T12:04Z; exact runtime placement not re-resolved for each block
